request: Remove the remaining top-surface seam geometry that still appeared to sit on the stone.
route: deterministic img2threejs component reconstruction followed by source GLB export, Blender MCP close-angle validation and optimization, optimized GLB re-import, and Unity prefab rebuild
userDecision: revision-requested because the copper finial flute capsules remained separate geometry floating above the top stone surface
rootCause: V5 made the seam meshes conform to the torus, but they remained separate colored solids over the top faces. Surface conformity removed side overhang without making the seams genuine stone-block boundaries.
changes: removed every overlaid seam mesh from the lower and upper rim top surfaces
rebuilt the lower rim as sixteen individually capped limestone torus segments
rebuilt the upper rim as eight individually capped limestone torus segments
created narrow physical gaps between adjacent stones so separation is part of the rim geometry
kept the tapered basin-wall and lathed upper-bowl vertical seams as nearly flush embedded closed solids
retained the existing five-material and eight-draw-call limits

validation.browserCapture: not repeated because the local browser URL was blocked in the preceding correction pass; exact exported geometry was reviewed through Blender

limitations: Vertical wall and upper-bowl seams remain separate embedded solids rather than destructive mortar cuts.
Water jets and impacts remain runtime/review effects excluded from structural GLB and FBX geometry.
Android device performance and final user art-direction approval remain pending.
